$comment: Phase-8 native acceptance record (P9 §3-§9). Hand-authored QA evidence, updated only with real evidence. Categories: validated_on_device (ran on physical hardware), automated_tested (behavior pinned by the automated suites against the provider double / pure machine), compiled_only (native artifacts build but the behavior never executed), not_tested (no evidence of any kind). Never upgrade a category without the corresponding evidence.

routesProbed.adb: not installed; no Android SDK, no ANDROID_HOME, no emulator images
routesProbed.xcrun: not available — Linux host, iOS tooling impossible
routesProbed.easBuild: api.expo.dev egress-blocked by environment network policy (connect_rejected); additionally the project's EAS identity belongs to upstream and must not be used to manufacture access

deviceAccessAttempt.conclusion: no physical-device route exists in this environment; release readiness remains CONDITIONAL on this gate

matrixNotes.automated_tested: pinned by the pure attempt-machine suite, the adapter suite over a controllable provider double, the jest hook/exercise/gate suites, and the browser E2E — these verify APP LOGIC, not real recognizer behavior
matrixNotes.compiled_only: expo prebuild (Android + iOS) and the Hermes/Android export succeed with the speech module and permission strings present; the code path never executed against a real recognizer
matrixNotes.not_tested: requires a physical microphone + platform recognizer; no honest evidence exists

learnerAccentCanary.reason: requires human participants speaking into real hardware; impossible in this environment and never to be simulated
learnerAccentCanary.protocol: when hardware + participants exist: clear French, accented French, hesitant French, number phrases, elision, common verbs, short formulaic expressions; record outcome CATEGORIES only (accepted / near-miss rejected / technical), no identities, no retained audio, no dataset

stopRaceExpectation.pinned: automated: stop-then-lost-verdict finalizes as technical no_final_result — never a wrong answer, never a promoted partial, never FSRS Again, never checkpoint/placement weakness

disclosure.networkBackedRecognition: implemented (P9 §7): one-time in-flow disclosure gates the first recording whenever the system recognizer may use the network (no proven offline French model); acknowledgement persisted as speechNoticeAckAt; also shown in the spoken-checkpoint preflight before a scored session

checkpointPreflight.status: implemented (P9 §8): capability hard-blocks, permission explained and requestable AT the preflight (point of use = starting the check), blocked permission ends in Settings/Back with no attempt created, network disclosure acknowledged before start
